tasks.title: Decision: Electrical sub-team scope boundaries
tasks.body:
Question: ELEC-007 and ELEC-009 overlap ELEC-005, ELEC-003, and ELEC-001; ELEC-008 states a control architecture that Controls owns; ELEC-010 to ELEC-012 cover sensor reading, logging, and a GUI that the program documents assign to Controls; a custom PCB is listed as a next goal although custom PCBs are deferred until bench validation; "motor drivers" in ELEC-007 is not a separate Baseline element.
Recommended: Controls keeps control law, state machine, sensor-reading firmware, and logging firmware. Electrical sub-teams own electrical architecture, interface definitions, and bench demonstrations. Name one Electrical lead of record for the sub-teams. Narrow ELEC-005 to wiring map, connectors, and CAN physical layer after ELEC-007. Hold custom PCB.

tasks.body:

Recommended: if settled, record the decision with approver, threshold (if any), turnaround, and reimbursement route, then close PROJ-004.
Blocks: PROJ-004, ELEC-016.

tasks.title: Decision: Mechanical sub-team ownership and boundaries
tasks.body:

Recommended: Mechanical owns routing paths, clearances, enclosure geometry, mounting, and ventilation. Electrical owns wire gauge, connectors, CAN physical layer, pack electrical build, BMS selection, and dissipation figures. The Mechanical lead names one owner per Mechanical package and records helpers on named packages.
Blocks: MECH-005 to MECH-007, I-01, I-05.

Recommended: keep SOLIDWORKS. Accept Fusion for concept layout only if delivered with a STEP export that imports into SOLIDWORKS.
Blocks: MECH-007.

Internal reference: PD-19.

tasks.title: Decision: passive ankle definition and clutch trigger
tasks.body:
Question: the ankle is a passive cable-and-spring design, but MECH-007 asks for a clutch that engages by gait event. The trigger is not stated: mechanical, triggered by foot contact; or electrically commanded, which adds a powered actuator, a power and signal interface (I-10), and moves the ankle from passive to semi-active.
Recommended: Phase 1 scope is unpowered, mechanically triggered options only, unless a decision adds a powered clutch.
Blocks: MECH-007, I-10.

tasks.title: Decision: battery enclosure insulation and thermal approach
tasks.body:

Recommended: MECH-005 states the purpose and heat inputs and compares both materials against that purpose, with the manufacturer temperature rating per row. The choice is recorded as a decision at the design review, before any purchase.
Blocks: MECH-005, any material purchase.

Recommended: either state that Controls stays as two named owners with no sub-teams, or assign Controls sub-teams at the next kickoff, in which case Drive folders and board items follow.
